id.description:
A unique identifier that can be manually assigned or generated automatically during object creation. This
identifier cannot be altered after the object has been persisted.

version.description:
Version number used for optimistic concurrency.  Automatically managed by the system.

Updating an Obj with a null or 0 value for version will cause the concurrency check to be skipped and should only
be done with great caution.

typeWithBindings.description: Persists concrete type with bindings for generic types where instance has parameter bindings

diagram.description: {@link ParsableDiagram} this asset is extracted from.

parsedText.description: The text associated with the detected sensor.

actualSensor.description: Reference to the currently proposed {@link MasterSensor} entity corresponding to this detected sensor.

originalMatchedActualSensor.description:
Reference to the original {@link MasterSensor} entity matched to this {@link ParsedSensor} by the {@link StringMatchingPipe}.
This field should not be changed after it is set.

isVerified.description: Flag indicating if this parsed sensor has been manually verified to be a match to the linked {@link actualSensor}.

collidingSensors.description: All parsed sensors from any {@link ParsableDiagram} which is currently matched to the same {@link Sensor}.

isDuplicate.description: Flag indicating if any other parsed sensors are matched to the same {@link actualSensor} as this parsed sensor.

matchConfidenceScore.description: Match confidence score of this {@link ParsedSensor} computed in the {@link ImageToTextPipe}.

matchConfidenceLevel.description: The current match confidence level of this {@link ParsedSensor} calculated based on {@link matchConfidenceScore}.

title: This type represents a detected sensor from a parsed diagram.
name: ParsedSensor
